plugins.name: adage
plugins.description: Agent traces become reflexes: Adage learns the paths your agents take in each repository and tells them, deterministically, what to do next, and, once you allow a step, does it for them. Works from the first session: binaries for macOS, Linux and Windows are bundled and verified, execution included; nothing is downloaded.

plugins.name: adage-exec
plugins.description: Retired: the adage plugin now includes execution. This alias quiets what an earlier version of this plugin left behind; uninstall it.
